evidence_summary: For every shift that starts at 10:00 but ends at a different hour—most importantly the canonical `ShiftWindow(10, 22)` recognized by `is_10_22h_shift`—this new disjunct makes `is_24h_shift` return true. Because `classify_shift` checks that predicate first, these shifts now return `covered_by_24h` and never reach the dedicated `covered_by_10_22h` branch, corrupting coverage classification; keep the 24-hour condition limited to equal start and end hours.
